description: Pack-local Evidence types for remote resilient microgrid commissioning (legacy diesel, DDIL, and mission-owner handoff facts not covered by reusable BESS or solar/PCS catalogs).

types.description: Redacted load-bank baseline record is attached or referenced as an immutable Evidence item.
Instrumented frequency/governor response remains inside the configured band during the load step.
Relay or overspeed trip path reports the expected trip/clear state during the test.
Switch controller or commissioning input records the expected transfer position, not only a verbal witness.
Controller or ledger trace confirms diesel/storage handoff completed in the approved order.
Local ledger accepts SAT events while disconnected from the uplink.
Reconnection sync preserves locally appended event IDs and ordering.
Export manifest references the handoff ledger and SAT log artifacts for the mission owner.
